================================================================================
Pointer indirection over casts and arithmetic

using System;
class C {
  unsafe int M(IntPtr p, char* a, int i, byte* q, int* e0) {
    int z = *(int*)p;
    char c = *(a + i);
    uint u = *(uint*)q;
    int w = *q++;
    return z + w + *(int*)&e0;
  }
}

class C {
  unsafe void M(byte* ptr, int pos, int off) {
    ref byte r = ref *(ptr + pos + off);
    int* q = GetP();
    *q = 1;

  unsafe static int* GetP() => null;
}

================================================================================
Null-conditional and ref-conditional assignment
================================================================================

using System;
class C {
  public int X;
  void M(C? c, int[]? a, int v, bool b, ref int x, ref int y) {
    c?.X = v;
    a?[0] = v;
    (b ? ref x : ref y) = v;
  }
}

================================================================================
Extension blocks
================================================================================

using System;
static class P {
  extension(float) {
    public static bool IsF(float x) => x > 0;
  }
}
struct V<T> {
  extension<T>(V<T>) where T : struct {
    public static int N() => 0;
  }
}

================================================================================
Method bodies split across preproc branches
================================================================================

using System;
class C {
  void M()
#if X
  => A();
#else
  { B(); }
#endif
  void A() {}
  void B() {}
  public static bool P
#if F
  => true;
#else
  => false;
#endif
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(compilation_unit
  (using_directive
    (identifier))
  (class_declaration
    (identifier)
    (declaration_list
      (method_declaration
        (predefined_type)
        (identifier)
        (parameter_list)
        (preproc_if
          (identifier)
          (arrow_expression_clause
            (invocation_expression
              (identifier)
              (argument_list)))
          (preproc_else
            (block
              (expression_statement
                (invocation_expression
                  (identifier)
                  (argument_list)))))))
      (method_declaration
        (predefined_type)
        (identifier)
        (parameter_list)
        (block))
      (method_declaration
        (predefined_type)
        (identifier)
        (parameter_list)
        (block))
      (property_declaration
        (modifier)
        (modifier)
        (predefined_type)
        (identifier)
        (preproc_if
          (identifier)
          (arrow_expression_clause
            (boolean_literal))
          (preproc_else
            (arrow_expression_clause
              (boolean_literal))))))))

================================================================================
Const initializers and accessors split across preproc branches
================================================================================

using System;
class C {
  private const int N =
#if M
  10;
#else
  300;
#endif
  public ulong Q {
#if B
  get => 1;
  set { }
#else
  get => 2;
#endif
  }
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  (using_directive
    (identifier))

        (predefined_type)
        (identifier)
        (preproc_if
          (identifier)
          (integer_literal)
          (preproc_else
            (integer_literal))))
      (property_declaration
        (modifier)
        (predefined_type)
        (identifier)
        (accessor_list
          (preproc_if
            (identifier)
            (arrow_expression_clause
              (integer_literal))
            (block)
            (preproc_else
              (arrow_expression_clause
                (integer_literal)))))))))
